yellow_sign.description: Hastur brands enemies with the Yellow Sign. Attacks an enemy and brands them for 3 turns. Branded enemies take 25% more damage.

unspeakable_one.name: The Unspeakable One
unspeakable_one.description: Hastur's true form drives enemies mad. Attacks all enemies with irresistible damage. Silences and provokes for 2 turns.

deep_one_call.name: Deep One Call
deep_one_call.description: Dagon commands the depths. Attacks an enemy and decreases ATB by 50%. If target has less than 30% ATB, stuns for 1 turn.

tidal_horror.name: Tidal Horror
tidal_horror.description: Dagon unleashes a tidal wave of terror. Attacks all enemies, resets their ATB to 0, and decreases Attack Speed for 2 turns.

sleeper_touch.name: Sleeper's Touch
sleeper_touch.description: Tsathoggua's lazy swipe drains life. Attacks an enemy and drains 50% of damage as HP. Inflicts Unrecoverable for 2 turns.

formless_spawn.name: Formless Spawn
formless_spawn.description: Tsathoggua's formless servants attack. Attacks all enemies and applies Continuous Damage for 3 turns. Heals self by 30% MAX HP.

wind_walk.name: Wind Walk
wind_walk.description: Ithaqua stalks through the frozen winds. Attacks an enemy and decreases Speed for 2 turns. Increases own ATB by 25%.

freezing_grasp.name: Freezing Grasp
freezing_grasp.description: The Wind-Walker freezes all. Attacks all enemies with 75% chance to freeze for 1 turn. Frozen enemies take 50% more damage from this attack.

fish_strike.name: Fish Strike
fish_strike.description: The Deep One strikes with webbed claws. Attacks an enemy 2 times, each hit has 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

tidal_assault.name: Tidal Assault
tidal_assault.description: Deep Ones swarm the enemy. Attacks an enemy 4 times, ignoring 30% defense. Each hit heals self by 10% of damage.

protoplasmic_slam.name: Protoplasmic Slam
protoplasmic_slam.description: The Shoggoth forms a massive pseudopod. Attacks an enemy with damage scaling on own MAX HP. Has 30% chance to stun.

absorb_mass.name: Absorb Mass
absorb_mass.description: The Shoggoth absorbs enemies into its mass. Attacks all enemies and absorbs 20% of damage as shield for 2 turns. Shield stacks.

brain_cylinder.name: Brain Cylinder
brain_cylinder.description: Mi-Go extracts knowledge. Attacks an enemy and steals 1 buff. If successful, increases own ATB by 30%.

yuggoth_science.name: Yuggoth Science
yuggoth_science.description: Mi-Go uses alien technology. Attacks all enemies and strips all buffs. Grants self 1 random buff per buff stripped.

silent_flight.name: Silent Flight
silent_flight.description: Night-Gaunt swoops silently. Attacks an enemy and reduces their ATB by 25%. Cannot be counterattacked.

tickle_torment.name: Tickle Torment
tickle_torment.description: Night-Gaunts tickle their victim relentlessly. Attacks an enemy 5 times. Each hit has 20% chance to stun for 1 turn. Stuns refresh.

ancient_technology.name: Ancient Technology
ancient_technology.description: Elder Thing activates ancient devices. Attacks an enemy and extends all debuffs by 1 turn. Inflicts Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

star_memory.name: Star Memory
star_memory.description: Elder Thing recalls aeons of knowledge. Resets all ally cooldowns by 1 turn and grants Skill Damage Increase buff for 2 turns.

petrifying_gaze.name: Petrifying Gaze
petrifying_gaze.description: Ghatanothoa's horrific visage petrifies. Attacks an enemy with 30% chance to petrify (stun) for 2 turns. Ignores immunity.

living_mummy.name: Living Mummy
living_mummy.description: Ghatanothoa mummifies the living. Attacks all enemies and has 50% chance to turn them into mummies (stun + heal block) for 1 turn.

web_of_dreams.name: Web of Dreams
web_of_dreams.description: Atlach-Nacha spins her great web. Attacks an enemy and inflicts Sleep for 2 turns. Sleeping enemies take 30% increased damage.

spider_god_strike.name: Spider God's Strike
spider_god_strike.description: Atlach-Nacha strikes with divine venom. Attacks all enemies with poison for 3 turns. Sleeping enemies are instantly awakened and stunned instead.

club_smash.name: Club Smash
club_smash.description: Hercules smashes with his mighty club. Attacks an enemy with damage scaling on own HP. 50% chance to stun for 1 turn.

twelve_labors.name: Twelve Labors
twelve_labors.description: Hercules channels the strength of his legendary labors. Grants self Attack Buff, Defense Buff, and Immunity for 3 turns. Cleanses all debuffs.

swift_spear.name: Swift Spear
swift_spear.description: Achilles strikes with blinding speed. Attacks an enemy 2 times, ignoring 30% defense. Increases own ATB by 20%.

wrath_of_achilles.name: Wrath of Achilles
wrath_of_achilles.description: Achilles unleashes his legendary rage. Attacks all enemies, ignoring 50% defense. Damage increases by 30% for each dead ally.

winged_strike.name: Winged Strike
winged_strike.description: Perseus swoops in with winged sandals. Attacks an enemy and decreases ATB by 30%. Cannot be counterattacked.

medusa_head.name: Medusa's Head
medusa_head.description: Perseus reveals the Gorgon's head. Attacks all enemies with 40% chance to petrify (stun) for 1 turn. Petrified enemies take 50% more damage.

cunning_strike.name: Cunning Strike
cunning_strike.description: Odysseus strikes with tactical precision. Attacks an enemy and strips 1 buff. If successful, decreases skill cooldowns by 1.

trojan_stratagem.name: Trojan Stratagem
trojan_stratagem.description: Odysseus executes a brilliant plan. Decreases all enemy ATB by 50% and inflicts Defense Break for 2 turns. Increases all ally ATB by 30%.

swift_arrow.name: Swift Arrow
swift_arrow.description: Atalanta fires with deadly accuracy. Attacks an enemy with increased crit rate. Speed scaling damage.

hunters_pursuit.name: Hunter's Pursuit
hunters_pursuit.description: Atalanta chases down prey. Attacks an enemy 4 times. Each hit increases own ATB by 10%. Gains extra turn if target dies.

soothing_melody.name: Soothing Melody
soothing_melody.description: Orpheus plays a calming song. Heals an ally by 20% HP and cleanses 1 debuff.

song_of_eurydice.name: Song of Eurydice
song_of_eurydice.description: Orpheus sings of his lost love. Heals all allies by 25% HP and grants Recovery buff for 2 turns. Revives one dead ally with 30% HP.

sword_thrust.name: Sword Thrust
sword_thrust.description: Theseus strikes with his father's sword. Attacks an enemy with 30% chance to inflict Bleed for 2 turns.

labyrinth_navigator.name: Labyrinth Navigator
labyrinth_navigator.description: Theseus finds the true path. Grants all allies Accuracy buff and removes inability effects. Reveals enemy buffs and cooldowns.

gram_slash.name: Gram Slash
gram_slash.description: Sigurd strikes with the legendary sword Gram. Attacks an enemy, ignoring 25% defense. Bonus damage vs dragons/beasts.

dragon_heart.name: Dragon Heart
dragon_heart.description: Sigurd's dragon blood protects him. Grants self Immunity and increases resistance by 50% for 3 turns. Reflects 30% damage taken.

mighty_grip.name: Mighty Grip
mighty_grip.description: Beowulf grapples with tremendous strength. Attacks an enemy and provokes for 1 turn. Damage scales on own defense.

monster_slayer.name: Monster Slayer
monster_slayer.description: Beowulf attacks with heroic fury. Attacks an enemy with massive damage. Bonus 100% damage vs bosses. Heals self by 30% of damage dealt.

valkyrie_spear.name: Valkyrie Spear
valkyrie_spear.description: Brynhildr throws her divine spear. Attacks an enemy and decreases ATB by 25%. If target has buffs, steals one.

shieldmaiden_stance.name: Shieldmaiden Stance
shieldmaiden_stance.description: Brynhildr takes a defensive stance. Grants all allies Defense buff and Shield equal to 15% of her max HP for 2 turns.

viking_axe.name: Viking Axe
viking_axe.description: Ragnar strikes with his battleaxe. Attacks an enemy and inflicts Bleed for 2 turns. Damage increases vs bleeding enemies.

saga_of_ragnar.name: Saga of Ragnar
saga_of_ragnar.description: Ragnar's legend inspires his allies. Grants all allies Attack buff for 2 turns. If Ragnar is below 50% HP, also grants Endure buff.

gae_bolg.name: Gáe Bolg
gae_bolg.description: Cú Chulainn hurls his cursed spear. Attacks an enemy, ignoring 100% defense. This attack always lands a critical hit.

warp_spasm.name: Warp Spasm
warp_spasm.description: Cú Chulainn transforms into a berserker. Attacks all enemies 3 times. Gains 50% more damage but loses 10% HP per attack.

wisdom_thumb.name: Wisdom of the Thumb
wisdom_thumb.description: Fionn consults his wisdom. Attacks an enemy and reveals all their stats, buffs, and cooldowns. Increases own accuracy by 50% for 2 turns.

fianna_call.name: Call of the Fianna
fianna_call.description: Fionn summons his warriors. Grants all allies Speed buff and increases ATB by 25%. Removes inability effects from all allies.

queens_fury.name: Queen's Fury
queens_fury.description: Boudicca attacks with righteous anger. Attacks an enemy with damage that increases as her HP decreases.

iceni_uprising.name: Iceni Uprising
iceni_uprising.description: Boudicca rallies her people. Attacks all enemies and grants all allies Attack buff for 2 turns. Damage increases per ally.

architects_blessing.name: Architect's Blessing
architects_blessing.description: Imhotep designs divine protection. Grants an ally a Shield equal to 25% of their max HP for 3 turns.

pyramid_power.name: Pyramid Power
pyramid_power.description: Imhotep channels ancient architecture. Grants all allies Shield equal to 20% HP and Defense buff for 3 turns. Extends all ally buffs by 1 turn.

royal_charm.name: Royal Charm
royal_charm.description: Cleopatra beguiles an enemy. Attacks an enemy with 75% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Steals 1 buff.

asps_embrace.name: Asp's Embrace
asps_embrace.description: Cleopatra summons deadly serpents. Attacks all enemies with poison for 3 turns. Enemies with poison take 25% more damage.

ruyi_jingu_bang.name: Ruyi Jingu Bang
ruyi_jingu_bang.description: Sun Wukong swings his magical staff. Attacks an enemy 3 times. Each hit has 30% chance to stun for 1 turn.

seventy_two_transformations.name: 72 Transformations
seventy_two_transformations.description: Sun Wukong creates clones of himself. Summons 2 clones that attack random enemies. Grants self Immunity and 50% ATB.

green_dragon_blade.name: Green Dragon Crescent Blade
green_dragon_blade.description: Guan Yu sweeps with his legendary polearm. Attacks all enemies with 50% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

warrior_gods_fury.name: Warrior God's Fury
warrior_gods_fury.description: Guan Yu unleashes divine wrath. Attacks an enemy with massive damage, ignoring 50% defense. Grants self Attack buff for 2 turns.

niten_ichi_ryu.name: Niten Ichi-ryū
niten_ichi_ryu.description: Musashi strikes with two swords. Attacks an enemy 2 times. Each attack has 50% increased crit rate.

musashis_void.name: Musashi's Void
musashis_void.description: Musashi achieves perfect emptiness. Attacks an enemy, ignoring all buffs and defense. Guaranteed critical hit. Resets if target survives.

sky_piercer.name: Sky Piercer
sky_piercer.description: Lu Bu thrusts with his halberd. Attacks an enemy with massive damage. Ignores 40% defense.

unmatched_warrior.name: Unmatched Warrior
unmatched_warrior.description: Lu Bu fights with unrivaled ferocity. Attacks all enemies with devastating force. Damage increases by 50% but cannot be healed for 2 turns.

divine_radiance.name: Divine Radiance
divine_radiance.description: Amaterasu shines her light upon an ally. Heals by 20% HP and grants Immunity for 1 turn.

heavenly_illumination.name: Heavenly Illumination
heavenly_illumination.description: The Sun Goddess reveals her true glory. Heals all allies by 30% HP, cleanses all debuffs, and grants Attack buff for 2 turns.

storm_blade.name: Storm Blade
storm_blade.description: Susanoo strikes with the Kusanagi sword. Attacks an enemy 2 times with 40% chance to stun per hit.

yamata_no_orochi.name: Yamata no Orochi
yamata_no_orochi.description: Susanoo summons the eight-headed serpent's fury. Attacks all enemies 3 times with lightning damage. Each hit decreases ATB by 15%.

moonlight_slash.name: Moonlight Slash
moonlight_slash.description: Tsukuyomi cuts with cold moonlight. Attacks an enemy and decreases their Speed for 2 turns. Ignores 20% defense.

eternal_night.name: Eternal Night
eternal_night.description: Tsukuyomi plunges the battlefield into darkness. Attacks all enemies, putting them to sleep for 1 turn. Sleeping enemies take 50% more damage.

thunder_drum.name: Thunder Drum
thunder_drum.description: Raijin beats his drums of thunder. Attacks an enemy with 50% chance to stun for 1 turn. Increases own ATB by 20%.

divine_lightning.name: Divine Lightning
divine_lightning.description: Raijin calls down heaven's wrath. Attacks all enemies with 75% chance to stun for 1 turn. Critical hits extend stun by 1 turn.

wind_bag.name: Wind Bag
wind_bag.description: Fujin releases wind from his bag. Attacks an enemy and decreases ATB by 35%. Increases own Speed for 2 turns.

divine_tempest.name: Divine Tempest
divine_tempest.description: Fujin unleashes all his winds. Attacks all enemies and resets their ATB to 0. Increases all ally ATB by 25%.

heavenly_spear.name: Heavenly Spear
heavenly_spear.description: Bishamonten strikes with divine authority. Attacks an enemy and grants self Defense buff for 2 turns.

fortune_warriors_blessing.name: Fortune Warrior's Blessing
fortune_warriors_blessing.description: Bishamonten blesses his allies with fortune. Grants all allies Defense buff and Shield equal to 20% HP for 3 turns.

heavenly_jeweled_spear.name: Heavenly Jeweled Spear
heavenly_jeweled_spear.description: Izanagi stirs creation. Attacks an enemy and creates a shield on the lowest HP ally equal to damage dealt.

creation_divine.name: Divine Creation
creation_divine.description: Izanagi calls upon the power of creation. Revives all dead allies with 25% HP and grants them Immunity for 1 turn.

fox_fire.name: Fox Fire
fox_fire.description: Inari summons ghostly flames. Attacks an enemy with 50% chance to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns.

blessing_of_prosperity.name: Blessing of Prosperity
blessing_of_prosperity.description: Inari grants divine fortune. Heals all allies by 20% HP and increases their ATB by 20%. Grants Recovery buff for 2 turns.

war_gods_arrow.name: War God's Arrow
war_gods_arrow.description: Hachiman fires a divine arrow. Attacks an enemy with guaranteed hit. Damage increases by 20% per buff on self.

divine_protection.name: Divine Protection
divine_protection.description: Hachiman shields his warriors. Grants all allies Defense buff and Endure for 2 turns. Cleanses 2 debuffs from each.

divine_music.name: Divine Music
divine_music.description: Benzaiten plays her biwa. Heals an ally by 15% HP and increases their ATB by 30%.

river_of_fortune.name: River of Fortune
river_of_fortune.description: Benzaiten's music flows like water. Heals all allies by 25% HP and grants Speed buff for 2 turns. Cleanses all debuffs.

foxfire_blast.name: Foxfire Blast
foxfire_blast.description: Kitsune hurls mystical fire. Attacks an enemy with 40% chance to inflict Continuous Damage for 2 turns.

illusion_tails.name: Illusion Tails
illusion_tails.description: Kitsune creates illusory copies. Attacks all enemies with 30% chance to provoke for 1 turn. Increases own evasion for 2 turns.

wind_slash.name: Wind Slash
wind_slash.description: Tengu slashes with the wind. Attacks an enemy and decreases Speed for 2 turns. Cannot be counterattacked.

mountain_warrior.name: Mountain Warrior
mountain_warrior.description: Tengu demonstrates mountain combat. Attacks an enemy 3 times. Each hit has 25% chance to decrease Defense for 1 turn.

kanabo_smash.name: Kanabo Smash
kanabo_smash.description: Oni smashes with its iron club. Attacks an enemy with damage scaling on own HP. 30% chance to stun.

demon_rage.name: Demon Rage
demon_rage.description: Oni goes berserk. Attacks all enemies with 50% increased damage but takes 15% recoil damage.

water_sumo.name: Water Sumo
water_sumo.description: Kappa challenges an enemy to sumo. Attacks and provokes for 1 turn. Heals self by 15% if provoke succeeds.

river_drag.name: River Drag
river_drag.description: Kappa drags enemies into the water. Attacks all enemies and decreases ATB by 25%. Heals self by 20% HP.

eight_boat_leap.name: Eight Boat Leap
eight_boat_leap.description: Yoshitsune performs his legendary leap. Attacks an enemy 4 times, ignoring 25% defense. Each hit increases own ATB by 10%.

tengu_training.name: Tengu Training
tengu_training.description: Yoshitsune uses techniques taught by the Tengu. Attacks all enemies and grants self Evasion and Speed buff for 2 turns.

naginata_strike.name: Naginata Strike
naginata_strike.description: Tomoe strikes with her polearm. Attacks an enemy with 35% chance to decrease Defense for 2 turns.

onna_musha.name: Onna-Musha
onna_musha.description: Tomoe fights with the fury of a warrior woman. Attacks an enemy 3 times. Gains extra turn if enemy dies.

seven_weapons.name: Seven Weapons
seven_weapons.description: Benkei attacks with one of his collected weapons. Attacks an enemy and grants self a random buff for 2 turns.

standing_death.name: Standing Death
standing_death.description: Benkei stands unbreakable. Grants self Endure for 2 turns and provokes all enemies for 1 turn. Reflects 30% damage.

demon_king_strike.name: Demon King Strike
demon_king_strike.description: Nobunaga strikes with ruthless efficiency. Attacks an enemy, ignoring 35% defense. Extends all debuffs by 1 turn.

unification_by_force.name: Unification by Force
unification_by_force.description: Nobunaga conquers all who oppose. Attacks all enemies with devastating force. Damage increases by 30% for each enemy with debuffs.
